Africa/Abidjan|Accra.headline: Possession is a crime punished by fine; licensed low-THC medical/industrial use only
points: Personal-use possession: fine of 200-500 penalty units under Act 1019; default can mean jail
Unlicensed growing, supply and trafficking: long prison terms
Licences for low-THC (≤0.3%) growing for industry/medicine issued by NACOC from 2026
Same national law applies in Accra; no city-level rules

Africa/Abidjan|Reykjavik.headline: Possession is a crime; small personal amounts usually end in a police fine
points: Personal possession: police summary fine on a per-gram scale (cap 500,000 ISK)
Sale or supply: always prosecuted in court
Growing: illegal
Medical: no program; only Sativex on prescription

Africa/Johannesburg|Harare.headline: Personal use is a crime; licensed medical and research production since 2018
points: Possession for personal use: crime, punished with a fine and/or prison
Growing without a licence: illegal; licensed medical/research growing under SI 62/2018
Dealing: up to 15 years; 2025 High Court said fines first for first offenders
Medical: licensed production exists; access for individual patients is limited

Africa/Lagos|Algiers.headline: Illegal; possession means prison or treatment; no death sentence on record for this drug
points: Personal use: about 2 months-2 years prison, or court-ordered treatment (Law 04-18)
Growing and trafficking: long prison terms up to life
Law 25-03 (2025) allows death for aggravated trafficking; Algiers death sentences were for cocaine
No medical route

Africa/Lagos|Kinshasa.where: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
Africa/Lagos|Kinshasa.headline: Possession, growing and sale are crimes under the 1971 narcotics ordinance
points: No legal personal amount; possession can bring arrest, fines or prison
Growing illegal for individuals; trafficking reported up to 20 years
2021 ministerial order licenses low-THC medical growing by firms; no patient route
Enforcement uneven; pretrial detention is a real risk

America/Caracas|La Paz.headline: Illegal; personal use can mean committed treatment, trafficking 10-25 years
points: Law 1008 (1988) bans possession and use; no legal personal amount
Personal-use quantity: held in a treatment facility until 'rehabilitated'
Beyond a minimal amount: possession/trafficking charges; trafficking 10-25 yrs
No medical program; growing illegal

America/Chicago|Dallas.headline: Texas: recreational use is a crime; low-THC medical program (TCUP) is the only legal route
points: Possession up to 2 oz: Class B misdemeanor, up to 180 days jail and $2,000 fine
Growing is illegal; no adult-use shops
TCUP medical: low-THC products, 10 mg/dose cap; flower barred; expanded 9/2025 (HB 46)
Dallas Prop R (2024) local decriminalization blocked by court order since July 2025
America/Chicago|Dallas.varies: Some Texas cities voted local decriminalization; courts have blocked or struck most of these

America/Edmonton|Calgary.headline: Legal for adults 18+ in Alberta; up to 30 g in public, licensed stores
points: Age 18+ (Alberta's minimum); up to 30 g dried in public
Growing: up to 4 plants per household from legal seeds/plants
Sale outside licensed AGLC system is a crime; public-use limits set by city bylaw
Medical access via federal Cannabis Regulations licensed producers
America/Edmonton|Calgary.varies: Calgary bylaws restrict public consumption; landlords/condo boards may bar growing

America/Halifax|Bermuda.headline: Up to 7 g is not a criminal offence, but police seize it; use and growing still banned
points: Possession of 7 g or less: no criminal offence since 20 Dec 2017; police may seize any amount
Over 7 g: arrest and prosecution; consuming, growing, import and trafficking remain offences
Medical: doctor-prescribed use allowed; patients apply to import their own supply
2022 licensing bill for legal sales blocked by the Governor and the UK; not in force

America/Lima|Bogotá.headline: Personal dose up to 20 g is protected; sales illegal; public-space use restricted
points: Adults may carry up to 20 g (dosis personal, Law 30 of 1986); no crime (C-221/1994)
Growing up to 20 plants for personal use tolerated; no legal shops
Decree 2114 (Dec 2023) repealed the 2018 police seizure-and-fine procedure for personal doses; selling is still a crime
Medical: licensed products by prescription (Law 1787 of 2016)
America/Lima|Bogotá.varies: Bogotá and other cities may restrict use in parks and near schools under the Police Code
sources: https://sidn.ramajudicial.gov.co/SIDN/PUBLICACIONES PERIODICAS/TEXTO COMPLETO Y TABLAS DE CONTENIDO PP/Gaceta de la Corte Constitucional/Edición Extraordinaria. Sentencia C-221 de 1994.pdf

America/Lima|Panama.headline: Recreational possession illegal; 2021 medical law is reaching pharmacies
points: Personal-use possession remains penalized under the Penal Code
Possession not for personal use (Art. 321): long prison terms; trafficking (Art. 313): 8-15 yrs
Medical: Law 242 of 2021 created a licensed medical route; products entering pharmacies
Growing for personal use: illegal

America/Los_Angeles|Seattle.headline: Adults 21+ may possess and buy from licensed stores; home growing still barred
points: Age 21+: up to 1 oz flower, 16 oz solid edibles, 72 oz liquid, 7 g concentrate
Licensed retail stores since 2014; public use is a civil infraction
Growing: illegal for adult use; 2025-26 home-grow bills (HB 1449, SB 6204) not enacted
Medical: authorized patients may grow 6 plants (up to 15) and buy tax-free
America/Los_Angeles|Seattle.varies: Federal law still prohibits; federal land excluded

America/Mexico_City|Guatemala.headline: Illegal; even possession for personal use can mean prison
points: Possession for own use: 4 months to 2 years in prison plus a Q200-Q10,000 fine (Art. 39)
Growing: illegal
Trafficking or storage: 12-20 years in prison plus heavy fines
Medical: no legal program

America/New_York|Toronto.headline: Legal for adults 19+ in Ontario; buy from licensed stores or the Ontario Cannabis Store
points: Age 19+; up to 30 g dried (or equivalent) in public
Growing: up to 4 plants per residence, seeds from a legal source
Over the limit: ticket up to 5 yrs; illegal sale up to 14 yrs (federal)
Federal medical program available
America/New_York|Toronto.varies: Landlords and condo boards may ban growing or use in units

America/Noronha|South Georgia.where: South Georgia & South Sandwich Islands (UK territory)
America/Noronha|South Georgia.headline: UK territory with no permanent residents; controlled drugs banned under local ordinance
points: No permanent population; only scientists, officials and visiting ships
Applied law refers to a Dangerous Drugs Ordinance (Chapter 18) for drug offences
UK medical prescription route does not extend here; no local medical scheme
Ships and visitors are subject to territory law and permits

America/Sao_Paulo|Buenos Aires.headline: Private personal use protected by Supreme Court; registered medical growing
points: Federal Law 23.737 applies in the city and province; no local carve-out
Arriola (2009): private adult personal use not punishable; cases often dismissed
Public or larger possession: 1 month-6 yrs on paper; trafficking 4-15 yrs
Medical: REPROCANN registry allows registered home growing (tightened 2025)

Asia/Dhaka|Bishkek.headline: Illegal: small amounts fined, larger amounts bring criminal prison terms
points: Below the 'significant amount': fine (about 2,000 KGS reported), escalating on repeat
Above the threshold: criminal possession, prison up to about 5 years
Growing and sale are crimes; trafficking draws long prison terms
No medical program

Asia/Dubai|Baku.headline: Illegal; small personal amounts administrative, larger amounts criminal
points: Possession below a 'significant amount': administrative fine/detention (2023 amendment)
Above personal-use amount: criminal, Criminal Code art. 234.1, about 2-3 yrs prison
Growing and trafficking: crimes with multi-year prison terms
No medical route

Asia/Gaza|West Bank.headline: Illegal under PA Decree-Law 18 of 2015; prison for possession, long terms for trafficking
points: Possession, use, growing and sale banned under Decree-Law 18/2015 (amended 2020)
Personal use: prison and fines; trafficking and growing: 10+ years, up to life with hard labour
No death penalty for drug offences in PA law; death sentences reported are Gaza-only
Medical: no program
Asia/Gaza|West Bank.varies: Israeli settlements in Area C fall under Israeli law, not PA law

Asia/Jakarta|Bangkok.headline: Medical only since June 2025: flower sold only on a doctor's prescription
points: Flower reclassified as controlled herbal medicine; recreational use no longer lawful
Shops may sell only with a prescription, up to a 30-day personal supply
Sellers breaking the order face up to 1 year jail and ฿20,000 fine
Extracts over 0.2% THC remain narcotics; smuggling brings prison

Asia/Jakarta|Hanoi.headline: Illegal; Vietnamese courts have sentenced cannabis traffickers to death
points: Use: fines or compulsory rehab; use after rehab is a crime since 1 Jul 2025 (2-5 yrs)
Possession ≥1 kg leaf/flower or ≥1 g resin: 3-5 yrs, more for larger amounts
Sale of ≥150 kg leaf/flower or ≥30 kg resin: life or death (Art. 251(5))
No medical program
Asia/Jakarta|Hanoi.varies: National Penal Code applies uniformly; no Hanoi-specific rules
Asia/Jakarta|Hanoi.death_evidence: 12 Jun 2026: Quang Ninh Provincial People's Court sentenced Nguyen Phi Co and Nguyen Duy Manh to death in a 401 kg cannabis trafficking ring (national law, same in Hanoi)

Asia/Jerusalem|Tel Aviv.headline: Private personal use draws an administrative fine; large licensed medical program
points: Adult personal use/possession (about 15 g) in private: administrative fine, first time
Repeat offences, minors, or public use can still lead to prosecution
Growing and sale: criminal offences
Medical: licensed program via Health Ministry (IMCA), pharmacies dispense

Asia/Karachi|Tashkent.headline: Strictly illegal; long prison terms for trafficking
points: Possession without intent to sell: a fine or up to about 3 years in prison
Public drug use: up to 15 days of administrative detention
Trafficking: 7-10 yrs online or near schools; 15-20 yrs for large amounts (2026 law)
Medical: no legal program

Asia/Kolkata|Colombo.headline: Illegal; possession and growing are crimes with prison terms
points: Under 1 kg: fine Rs20,000-50,000 and/or 1-2 years (Poisons, Opium & Dangerous Drugs Ord.)
Larger amounts: 2-15 years by weight tier
Growing and trafficking illegal; death penalty applies to heroin, cocaine etc., not this drug
Only licensed Ayurvedic traditional preparations; no modern medical program

Asia/Kolkata|Delhi.headline: Illegal; national law: a death sentence was given for charas trafficking (Mumbai 2008)
points: Small quantity (ganja under 1 kg): up to 6 months RI and/or Rs10,000 fine
Commercial (20 kg+ ganja): 10-20 yrs; growing illegal without licence
Bhang (leaves) not listed under NDPS; no Delhi-specific ban found
Licensed Ayurvedic cannabis medicines only; no medical program
Asia/Kolkata|Delhi.death_evidence: National law (NDPS Act s.31A): Mumbai special court sentenced Ghulam Malik to death for 187 kg charas (2008; commuted 2012).

Asia/Manila|Beijing.headline: Strictly illegal; large-scale trafficking can carry the death penalty
points: Use/small possession: 10-15 days administrative detention plus fine
Repeat users may face compulsory treatment; no personal amount allowed
Trafficking large quantities (e.g. 150 kg+ leaf): 15 yrs, life or death
No medical program; national law applies in Beijing
Asia/Manila|Beijing.death_evidence: 16 Sept 1998: three men sentenced to death in Guangdong for smuggling over 4 tonnes of cannabis from Cambodia (Amnesty ASA 17/033/1998). Same national Criminal Law (Art. 347) governs Beijing.

Asia/Manila|Perth.headline: Recreational illegal in WA; up to 10 g diverted to intervention session; medical OK
points: Up to 10 g (adult, first time): police may issue Cannabis Intervention Requirement
Complete session within 28 days = no conviction; adults get only one CIR
Growing any plants and resin/oil are excluded from CIR and prosecuted
Medical: TGA-approved prescriptions available nationally
Asia/Manila|Perth.varies: Police discretion on CIR; only ACT (Canberra) allows adult personal possession

Asia/Manila|Singapore.headline: Zero tolerance: trafficking over 500 g carries death, and executions have taken place
points: Use or possession: up to 10 years and/or S$20,000; repeat users face caning
Over 15 g is presumed trafficking: 5-20 years plus caning
Over 500 g: death penalty under the Misuse of Drugs Act
No medical program; citizens can be charged for use abroad
Asia/Manila|Singapore.death_evidence: Tangaraju Suppiah was sentenced to death in 2018 for abetting trafficking of 1,017.9 g of cannabis and hanged on 26 Apr 2023 (Al Jazeera). Omar Yacob Bamadhaj was also hanged in 2022 for cannabis trafficking

Asia/Sakhalin|Magadan.headline: Illegal; under 6 g means a fine or up to 15 days arrest, more is criminal
points: Under 6 g: administrative offence, fine RUB 4,000-5,000 or up to 15 days arrest (Admin Code 6.8)
Over 6 g: criminal (CC Art. 228), up to 3 years; over 100 g: 3-10 years
Growing under 20 plants is administrative; more is criminal; foreigners face expulsion
Medical: no program; federal law applies the same in every region

Asia/Tokyo|Seoul.headline: Illegal: possession and use are crimes; only approved cannabis-derived medicines allowed
points: Use/possession: up to 5 years prison or fine up to ₩50M (Narcotics Control Act)
Growing and sale are criminal; for-profit import/export carries harsher terms
Medical: only approved drugs (e.g. Epidiolex) by prescription, case by case, since 2019
Koreans can be prosecuted for use abroad; no death sentence for this offence documented

Asia/Yangon|Cocos Islands.headline: WA drug law applies; small possession may be diverted; federal medical access
points: WA law applies via s8A Cocos (Keeling) Islands Act 1955, plus Commonwealth law
≤10 g (adult, first time): police may issue a Cannabis Intervention Requirement instead of charge
Growing plants and resin: prosecuted in court under the WA Misuse of Drugs Act 1981
Medical: TGA prescription access is Commonwealth-wide
Asia/Yangon|Cocos Islands.varies: Ordinances can amend or suspend applied WA laws in the Territory

Australia/Brisbane|Guam.headline: Adults 21+ may possess up to 1 oz and grow 6 plants; no retail sales yet
points: Age 21+: possess up to 1 oz; gifting up to 1 oz allowed, selling is not
Growing: 6 plants (3 flowering) in a locked space out of public view
Retail: first cultivation licenses 2026; no store sales reported as of mid-2026
Medical: separate program; public use and impaired driving prohibited
Australia/Brisbane|Guam.varies: US federal law still applies on military bases and federal land

Australia/Sydney|Melbourne.headline: Victoria: possession for personal use is a crime; police often caution; medical is legal
points: Up to 50 g, not for sale: offence, up to 5 penalty units (s73 DPCS Act 1981)
Police guidance (Sept 2024) recommends a caution for up to 50 g, but only about 37% of cases are cautioned
Growing: illegal; 10 plants or 250 g counts as a trafficable quantity
Medical: TGA-regulated prescriptions available nationally
Australia/Sydney|Melbourne.varies: May 2026: upper house motion urges putting cautions into law; no bill yet

Europe/Athens|Helsinki.headline: Illegal; personal use is fined; medical use only by special permit
points: Drug use offence (small amount): day-fines or up to 6 months; first-timers may be waived
Growing and sale: up to 2 years; aggravated 1-10 years (Criminal Code ch. 50)
Medical: Sativex on prescription; flower/oil only via Fimea special permit
Parliament rejected a legalisation citizens' initiative (vote reported Feb 2026)

Europe/Athens|Kyiv.headline: Medical route via pharmacy prescriptions since 2026; recreational possession prohibited
points: Under 5 g: administrative fine (Art. 44 CAO), no criminal record
Above small amount: criminal (Art. 309), up to 3 yrs; larger 2-5 yrs
Growing and trafficking criminal; trafficking 4-8 yrs
Medical law 2024; e-prescriptions, pharmacy dispensing since June 2026

Europe/London|Dublin.headline: Illegal; first-time small possession can go to a health referral (since Sept 2026); medical access programme
points: Possession illegal; first offence fine up to about EUR 1,000, repeat can mean jail
Health Referral Scheme (1 Sep 2026): adults 18+, small amount, one-time diversion
Dealing: up to life; EUR 13,000+ worth carries presumptive 10-yr minimum
Medical: MCAP access programme for 3 conditions, plus ministerial licences

Europe/London|Lisbon.headline: Decriminalized since 2001: personal possession is an administrative offence
points: Up to a 10-day supply (about 25 g herb, 5 g resin) goes to a Dissuasion Commission, not court
Since Law 55/2023 the quantity guide is indicative; intent decides personal use vs trafficking
Growing and sale remain crimes (trafficking 4-12 years)
Medical: legal by prescription since 2018 (Law 33/2018), pharmacy-dispensed

Europe/Moscow|Istanbul.headline: Illegal; personal use and possession carry 2-5 years' prison
points: Personal possession/use: 2-5 yrs prison (Penal Code art. 191, as amended 2014)
First offenders usually get deferred prosecution with treatment/probation
Sale/supply: 10+ yrs; unlicensed growing is a crime
No consumer medical route; only state-licensed farms grow cannabis

Europe/Moscow|Nairobi.headline: Illegal nationwide; prison terms even for personal-use possession
points: Possession for personal use: up to 10 years (NDPSC Act 1994, s.3); other possession up to 20 years
Courts hand down real terms: e.g. 5 years for 200 g (High Court, 2024)
Trafficking: up to life plus large fines; a 2024 Kilifi case drew 50 years
Medical: no program; legalisation bills have not passed

Europe/Paris|Berlin.headline: Legal since April 2024: possess 25 g, grow 3 plants; Berlin fines for use zones
points: Adults 18+ may possess 25 g in public and 50 g at home (KCanG)
Growing: 3 plants per adult; non-profit clubs licensed by LAGeSo
Berlin fine catalogue since 1 Nov 2024: use near schools/playgrounds is fined
No shops; medical by prescription via pharmacies
Europe/Paris|Berlin.varies: Berlin bans use near schools, playgrounds and in pedestrian zones 7:00-20:00

Europe/Paris|Madrid.headline: Private possession allowed; public possession or use fined from €601 (LO 4/2015)
points: Private possession for personal use: no penalty
Public possession/use: administrative fine from 601 EUR (Ley Orgánica 4/2015)
Growing visible to public is fined; trafficking is a crime
Medical: 2025 decree allows hospital-dispensed cannabis preparations
Europe/Paris|Madrid.varies: Social clubs in a legal grey zone; regional club laws struck down

Europe/Paris|Rome.headline: Personal possession is an administrative offence; sale and growing are crimes
points: Personal use: administrative sanctions, e.g. licence or passport suspension for 1-3 months
Sale and trafficking: criminal (DPR 309/1990 Art. 73); minor cases reduced penalties
Growing: criminal in principle; tiny domestic grows sometimes held non-punishable by courts
Medical: prescription access; reimbursement set by region (Lazio)

Pacific/Pago_Pago|Midway.where: Midway Atoll, US Minor Outlying Islands
Pacific/Pago_Pago|Midway.headline: US federal wildlife refuge; full federal criminal law applies, so possession is illegal
points: No permanent residents; Fish and Wildlife Service refuge, access by permit only
US criminal code applies in full (50 CFR 38.7); Hawaii law only where not in conflict
Federal possession: up to 1 year plus a minimum $1,000 fine (first offence)
Medical: no state program exists, so the federal medical carve-out can't apply

Pacific/Tongatapu|Samoa.headline: Possession and growing are crimes under the Narcotics Act 1967; no medical route
points: Class B narcotic: up to 14 years for possession or growing
2025 sentences: discharge or community service to 24 months jail
Supply/dealing punished more severely
No medical program
